title: Verify Dashboard Batch 3: Goals, Languages, Word Details, Layout
description: COMPREHENSIVE responsive verification at 320px, 375px, 768px, 1200px widths. Final UX/UI audit.

acceptanceCriteria.text: DESKTOP (1200px): Take full-page screenshot of complete dashboard
Verify 'My Goals' section with progress ring indicators
Click to customize a goal - verify modal works
Verify 'My Languages' section shows practiced languages
Click a language card - verify filtering works
Go to vocabulary, click a word - verify details modal opens
Verify word modal shows songs containing that word
TABLET (768px): Resize and take screenshot - verify 2-column layout
MOBILE (375px): Resize and take screenshot - verify single column
MOBILE (320px): Resize to smallest - verify no overflow/horizontal scroll
MOBILE: Verify bottom sheet for word details (not centered modal)
MOBILE: Test all collapsible sections expand/collapse smoothly
UX AUDIT: Verify visual hierarchy makes sense, easy to scan
UI AUDIT: Verify consistent spacing, shadows, rounded corners
Verify header has 'Dashboard' link when logged in
If ANY issues found: create US-DASH-FIX-* story
